pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Peter in Tears - the apostle in his yellow mantle over the blue green robe with his hands clasped and his eyes lifted brimming with tears and the keys hanging at his wrist, a song of ascents, out of the depths I cry to You O LORD, O Lord hear my voice, let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy
pictures.name: pd_greco_diepte

pictures.scene: Domenico Fetti, Moses before the burning bush - Moses seated on the rock unlacing his sandal with both hands and turning to look at the bush whose pale flames rise against the dark sky, if You O LORD kept track of iniquities then who O Lord could stand, but with You there is forgiveness so that You may be feared
pictures.name: pd_fetti_braambos

pictures.scene: Philippe Mercier, The Bible Lesson - the mother in her blue gown and white cap with her finger on the line of the open book on her lap and the small boy leaning in with both hands to his head to read it, I wait for the LORD my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope
pictures.name: pd_mercier_woord

pictures.scene: Moritz von Schwind, Die Morgenstunde - the girl standing at the open window of the quiet room with both hands on the sill looking out at the morning over the blue mountains while the first sunlight lies along the floor behind her, my soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning
pictures.name: pd_schwind_ochtend

pictures.scene: Jan Hackaert, Bergachtig landschap - the tall tree standing against the pale sky above the mountain ridge with the road running out into the wide sunlit distance and the travellers driving their flock along it, O Israel put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion and with Him is redemption in abundance, and He will redeem Israel from all iniquity
pictures.name: pd_hackaert_hoop

lines.text: I cry to You, O LORD!
let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities,
then who, O Lord, could stand?
But with You there is forgiveness,
so that You may be feared.
I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait,
and in His word I put my hope.
My soul waits for the Lord
more than watchmen wait for the morning—
more than watchmen wait for the morning.
O Israel, put your hope in the LORD,
for with the LORD is loving devotion,
and with Him is redemption in abundance.
